messages:
sophia: @here Heads-up: new dedicated A100X-80GB capacity coming online in eu-west-1 (single AZ) and eu-central-1 (extra AZ). Reservations open in Console now. Docs: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/a100x-eu-announce

nate: Inventory snapshot: eu-west-1 initial = 3 racks, eu-central-1 +1 AZ = 4 racks. Temporary per-customer cap = 2 racks in eu-west-1 until 2026-05-01.

ops_lead: Fallback policy: overflow will route to compatible H100 or L40s pools. Expect perf delta depending on model/context. Reserved pricing applies to confirmed racks; overflow billed at on-demand.

infra-bot: allocation created: dedicated:a100x:eu-west-1 (cap-17910). Templates pushed: reserved-a100x-eu-default.

sophia: TL;DR: A100X-80GB live in eu-west-1 + more in eu-central-1, per-customer caps in place, reserve via Console/API, fallback available. Office hours tomorrow 14:00 UTC for migrations. Ping @ops_lead for questions.
